notes:
{耳|みみ} refers to the ear, the organ of hearing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {耳|みみ}が{痛|いた}い: ear hurts
- {耳|みみ}が{遠|とお}い: hard of hearing
- {耳|みみ}にする: to hear about
- {耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける: to listen attentively
- {耳|みみ}をすます: to listen carefully

IDIOMS:
- {耳|みみ}が{早|はや}い: quick to hear news
- {耳|みみ}にたこができる: to hear something repeatedly (lit. "to get a callus on one's ear")
- {馬|うま}の{耳|みみ}に{念仏|ねんぶつ}: preaching to deaf ears

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {目|め}: eye
- {鼻|はな}: nose
- {口|くち}: mouth
